words.sense: Giving reasons to doubt honesty, accuracy, or reliability.
misconceptions: Confused with ambiguous when the defining clue is overlooked.

words.sense: Allowing two or more plausible meanings.
misconceptions: Confused with dubious when the defining clue is overlooked.

semantic_axes.description: Dubious gives grounds to distrust a claim; ambiguous leaves its meaning open to more than one reading.

edges.boundary_rule: Dubious gives grounds to distrust a claim; ambiguous leaves its meaning open to more than one reading.
clues_a: Giving reasons to doubt honesty, accuracy, or reliability.
clues_b: Unclear because it has multiple readings.
Allowing two or more plausible meanings.
irrelevant_clues: format, colour, or popularity unless they establish the boundary
location or timing that does not change the decisive feature

misconceptions.M1: Treating dubious as though it always means ambiguous.
misconceptions.M2: Treating ambiguous as though it always means dubious.
misconceptions.M3: Overvaluing a distracting detail instead of the decisive semantic distinction.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Yara’s delivery listing?

beats.text: The listing promised next-day delivery but offered neither a seller address nor a tracking procedure.
beats.decisive_clue: its reliability is undermined by missing seller details
beats.reason: This establishes that its reliability is undermined by missing seller details.

beats.text: Its five glowing reviews had all been posted within the same minute.
beats.decisive_clue: its reliability is undermined by missing seller details
beats.reason: The suspiciously timed reviews strengthen doubts about honesty, not uncertainty over what the promise means.

chains.feedback_short: Its reliability is undermined by missing seller details; that detail favors dubious.
chains.feedback_deep: The suspiciously timed reviews strengthen doubts about honesty, not uncertainty over what the promise means. Dubious gives grounds to distrust a claim; ambiguous leaves its meaning open to more than one reading.
chains.contrast_rule: Dubious questions truth; ambiguous questions meaning.

hints.attention: Judge credibility rather than the number of possible readings.
hints.axis: Dubious gives grounds to distrust a claim; ambiguous leaves its meaning open to more than one reading.
hints.contrast: Dubious questions truth; ambiguous questions meaning.
